title: CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
title_zh: CoT-Proxy：通过跨格式迁移蒸馏长程策略
abstract_en: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.
abstract_zh: 推理模型可以通过强化学习或成本更低的轨迹微调获得长程任务能力。传统轨迹微调同时模仿教师的思维链（chain-of-thought, CoT）和动作，但闭源教师通常不通过 API 公开完整思维链。本文发现，仅凭教师动作也能蒸馏长程策略：训练时将学生的推理块留空，并在由学生自身生成样本构成的回放缓冲区上施加 KL 损失，以限制模型偏离初始模型。推理时开启思考，学生仍能以自己的方式推理，同时执行从教师学到的策略。作者将这一现象称为跨格式迁移（cross-format transfer）。在 AppWorld 上，蒸馏 Qwen3.6-27B 的动作使 Qwen3-4B 的任务成功率从 7% 升至 18%，使 Qwen3-32B 从 12% 升至 25%；在空推理块之后加入简短的教师推理摘要（CoT-proxies），可将 Qwen3-4B 的成功率进一步提高至 35%。该方法不需要访问隐藏思维链：仅使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 的可见输出及其 API 返回的推理摘要，就能使 Qwen3-4B 在 AppWorld 和 SWE-bench Verified 上的成功率分别从 7% 升至 48%、从 3% 升至 28%。
key_points_zh: 动作蒸馏：训练时留空学生的推理块，仅模仿教师动作，并用学生自身生成样本上的 KL 损失限制模型漂移。
跨格式迁移：训练时不模仿教师推理，推理时开启思考后，学生仍能用自己的推理方式执行学到的策略。
在 AppWorld 上，仅蒸馏 Qwen3.6-27B 的动作，Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-32B 的成功率分别从 7% 升至 18%、从 12% 升至 25%；加入 CoT-proxies 后，Qwen3-4B 进一步达到 35%。
闭源教师同样适用：使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 的可见输出和 API 推理摘要，Qwen3-4B 在 AppWorld 和 SWE-bench Verified 上的成功率分别达到 48% 和 28%，基线为 7% 和 3%。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是用教师的动作轨迹更新通用文本与软件代理的长程策略，无需访问教师的隐藏推理。摘要给出留空推理块和用学生自身生成的回放样本施加 KL 约束的做法；两种学生模型的 AppWorld 成功率均有提升，但现有证据不足以分离各组件的作用。未涉及改进机制本身的迭代改进。
